video_title: Darren Waller’s dream offense is a nightmare for any defender 😳🔥

quotes.speaker: Matt Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Darren Waller's unstoppable dream offense with Aaron Rodgers and star receivers

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: I need your all-time dream offensive team.

text_blocks.speaker: Darren Waller
text_blocks.text: I got prime Aaron Rodgers. I got prime AP at running back. I got prime Julio Jones and Calvin Johnson at wide receiver. And I got me at tight end.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: That's a big ass running back. That's two big ass receivers. No defense in the world. And someone's going to throw it right in your chest.
